1521080.title: [ACL] In Global Mode, verify an auto added Access Rule is generated when add an enabled DNS Policy with unique configuration of Source/Service tab.
1521080.result:
When the Policy is enabled, one Allow Access Rule is added and enabled automatically with these settings:

• Src Zone and Dst Zone are the same: LAN.
• Source Address : X0 Subnet.
• Destination Address : LAN interface IP.
• Service : DNS (Name Service) UDP.
• Description : Auto rule for DNS policy.

The ACL is not allowed to delete.
